Changes here are security-sensitive: Code Owner review plus a security-reviewed:<sha7> label.

exceptions.reason: ACCEPTED RISK, not a false positive. evaluateCondition() runs eval() on author-authored screen condition strings. Input is editor-authored rather than end-user supplied, and expressions are pre-sanitised, but this remains real code execution. Tracked for replacement with a restricted expression evaluator; scan-conditional-expressions.ts inventories current usage.

REAL ISSUE, short-dated on purpose. /api/(.*) sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * while allowing Authorization headers, so any origin can call the API with a bearer token. Recorded as an exception only so the pipeline can be adopted; the fix is an explicit origin allowlist. Expires deliberately soon.
